A quest from the {wiki:Tibia Tales}: the caliph {npc:Kazzan} of Darashia wants at least one of the Djinn races on his side. You learn the Djinn greeting word from {npc:Melchior} and take a peace proposal to the Marid and/or the Efreet. At the end you receive 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
The Efreet and the Marid have been fighting for ages, but perhaps humans can make peace with them.
You **must not have started or completed** the {wiki:Blue Djinn Quest} or the {wiki:Green Djinn Quest}.
Nothing special. Bring potions for the trip through the desert.
Use the shortcut: say {key:peace} to {npc:Umar} instead of {key:appeasement} and you do not need to go to the green fortress.
This quest is incompatible with the Djinn quests: if you have already started one of them, you cannot do it.
In the fortresses, never attack the Djinn: always say the greeting word first.

{npc:Melchior} is an NPC who wanders around **Ankrahmun**. It may take a while to find him, but he does not leave the shaded area in the image and does not usually go far from his starting point. To get to **Ankrahmun**, take a boat and say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain.
Area where Melchior can wander in Ankrahmun
Go to **Darashia** and go up one floor in the castle to {npc:Kazzan}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}.

There are two ways. The **short** one is to go only to the Marid and say {key:peace}. The **normal** one is to go to both fortresses (in either order) and say {key:appeasement}; neither side accepts, but the mission counts all the same.
Get to the Blue Djinn Fortress

The Djinn fortresses are in the Kha'zeel mountains, next to **Ankrahmun** (south of Darashia). The {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Blue Djinn Fortress} (Ashta'daramai) is reached by the ramp into the mountains **north** of Ankrahmun; follow it to the fortress (watch out for the {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} on the way). The entrance doors only let through those who are **level 30** or higher. {npc:Umar} is at the entrance, one floor up.
Ramp to the Blue Djinn Fortress

Go to the {wiki:Blue Djinn Fortress} and talk to {npc:Umar}. Say {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission}, {key:Kazzan} and then {key:peace}. The Marid accept and you **do not need** to go to the green fortress: skip to section 4.
**Do not accept** joining the fight of the Marid or the Efreet, unless you want to pick that side in the Djinn quests: according to Melchior, once you choose there is no going back.
In the {wiki:Blue Djinn Fortress}, tell {npc:Umar} {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission}, {key:Kazzan} and {key:appeasement}. He refuses.

Go to the {wiki:Green Djinn Fortress} and tell {npc:Ubaid} {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission}, {key:Kazzan} (and {key:appeasement}, if he asks). He refuses too. The {wiki:Mal'ouquah|Green Djinn Fortress} (Mal'ouquah) is reached by the passage next to the oasis into the mountains; {npc:Ubaid} is at the entrance, one floor up (only those who are level 30+ get through).
Passage to the Green Djinn Fortress

Go back to {npc:Kazzan} in Darashia and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. You receive the reward (whichever method you used). To leave the fortresses, go back the same way to Ankrahmun and take the boat to **Darashia** ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}).
